summary: The proof passes sequential verification. After arXiv theorem search returned no matching entries, the references were checked directly in [Caro–D'Addezio, arXiv:2511.11444](https://arxiv.org/html/2511.11444). Theorems 7.3.1, 7.3.6, and 7.2.1 apply with constant coefficients and establish the asserted separation of the slope-one class and vanishing of the slope-zero class in the separated quotient; Definition 7.1.1 supplies exactly the topology used. The discrete quotient norm and lifted residue-field basis justify the bounded functional. The finite-precision tensor constructions extend it continuously to the completed differential modules, including those of the generic-special-point completion. The chain identity has the correct sign for the shift [-1], so it induces a left inverse to J on ordinary cohomology and proves the final nonvanishing assertion. No critical errors, gaps, or hard-prohibition violations were found.
